text.tspan: Scrap Chaotic (End Grain): step 1: Mill rough stock
Whole blank on the jointer (schematic, not to scale)
Mill and rip whole blanks before any crosscut. Blank length = max(305 mm, slices x (slice + kerf) + 2 x 25
mm trim). Never send a crosscut slice or piece shorter than 305 mm to the jointer or planer.

12.008" (≈12 1/64") crosscut after milling.

Blank lengths: catalog blankRule applied to the app cut list by boardviz; the app export does not apply the
rule yet.
Joint one face and one edge on the jointer, then plane to final thickness plus 1/8" (3 mm). Rest overnight,
then plane to final thickness. Take ~1/64" (0.4 mm) passes for the last two passes.
Final pass depth: ~1/64" (0.4 mm)
WARNING: Use push blocks on the jointer. Never joint stock shorter than 12" (305 mm) or
thinner than 1/2" (12.5 mm).
WARNING: Keep hands clear of the infeed and outfeed. Feed only boards at least 12" (305 mm)
long.
